shortDescription: Psycasts² — Diablo 2-style psycast skill levels, auto synergies, a PoE constellation spec tree, seven ascension constellations, meditation→awakening→3-tier enlightenment, enemy psycaster tiers, two pilgrimage quest chains, and an in-game synergy balance editor (dev tool).
body:
(spec excerpt - flat level cap, ISEKAI compat, psylink gate + random-Awakened spawn)

## Testing preference (standing)
ALWAYS launch with companion Modern Psycasts UI (`astryl.ModernPsycastsUI`). For FULL addon coverage also load every installed 1.6 VPE addon: dev.tobot.vpe.betterautocast, Aranmaho.Makai.Psycast, Waffle.FantasyPatches, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Hemosage, Danzen.VPE.BiotechIntegration, Aranmaho.RavenousEye.Wildhunter.Psycast, VPE.Horaxian.Sentinel, Aranmaho.RangerClass, mute.vpesensitivity, VPE.Aeromancer.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAeromancer, VPE.Anima.Sentinel, morton.RetextureVPEAnima, VPE.Arknights.Sentinel, VPE.Biohazard.Sentinel, VPE.Blader.Sentinel, VPE.Bugmancer.Sentinel, VPE.Framework.Sentinel, VPE.Deadlife.Sentinel, VPE.Geomancer.Sentinel, VPE.Gravcaster.Sentinel, VPE.Hydromancer.Sentinel, VPE.Luminis.Sentinel, VPE.Mechanitor.Sentinel, VPE.Neurophage.Sentinel, VPE.Oripathy.Sentinel, VPE.PhaseShift.Sentinel, VPE.Umbra.Sentinel, VPE.Veincaster.Sentinel, VPE.Voidweaver.Sentinel, morton.VPEAddOnPsycastCardRetextures, VanillaExpanded.VPE.Puppeteer. EXCLUDED: VPE.Gauranlen.Sentinel (declares missing dep vanillaexpanded.ideo.dryads -> spams VDE_AwakenedDryad PawnKindDef + dryad texture errors; re-add only if the Dryads mod gets installed), VPE.BiotechIntegration.Adendum (missing dep), gwibbo.morepsygenes + Sl4vP0weR.NoPsycasts (not 1.6), VPersonaWeaponsE (not a psycast addon). Palette pins (tools take "T: " prefix; category is NOT a path segment): "Actions\T: Force awakening (Tier I)", "Actions\T: Grant psycaster level (+1)". Known-unrelated noise: VPE .dds Texture2D load errors; stale palette pins from other sessions. cs-assets.json drift warnings for UI/Specs/* etc. are concatenation false positives; keep them. NOTE: isolated test sessions keep their OWN mod-settings config (test-savedata/Config/Mod_*.xml) — in-game tuning edits live there, but the Bake button writes ManualBalance.json into the mod folder itself, which persists.

## No trait system
The enlightenment tier is the PS_Enlightenment hediff (Severity = tier, brain-seated). There is NO enlightenment trait - SetTier/TierOf are 100% hediff-based; Traits.xml is empty.

## Psycaster level cap is FLAT (default 400), tier-independent
vpeLevelCap default 400 (slider 30-500), overrideVpeLevelCap default true -> ApplyVpeLevelCap writes VPE maxLevel. Patch_LevelCap.EffectiveMax = BaseMax() (no tier). levelCapPerTier removed. Migration balanceVersion 4->5.

## Psylink gate + random Awakened spawn (Patch_EnemyTiers, GenerateNewPawnInternal, Priority.Last)
Postfix: TryInjectTier (hostile psycaster -> chance enemyTierFreq of a tier upgrade), then GatePsylink (when `gateUntieredPsylinks`, default ON): skip Awakened+/PS_AncientPsycasters; eligible humanlikes (13+) roll awakenedSpawnChance (0.05) to spawn as fresh Awakened (EnsurePsycaster + ApplyTier 70/22/8); otherwise generated psylinks are stripped. Tunable; 0% = none.

## ISEKAI RPG compat
suppressIsekaiPsycastStats (default ON): Patch_IsekaiSuppress strips IsekaiLeveling.* StatParts from psycaster stats at startup when JellyCreative.IsekaiLeveling is active.

## In-game synergy balance editor (replaces the HTML/JSON export flow)
**Access:** psycast tab, dev mode ON -> "Balance editor (dev)" row above the respecs (Patch_PsycastTabRespec). Window_BalanceEditor captures the tab's pawn + Psycasts hediff + CompAbilities at open.
**UI (Modern-suite / Cube style, ~1560×800, sentence-case):** THREE panes. (1) Rail: every path, one tree at a time, edit badges. (2) Cards: dropdown chips for primary "Skill effect" (stat + ×0.25-×3 strength), "Gains power from" rows (source + stat + strength + remove/add, cap 6), "Empowers" rows (target + stat + strength + remove/add — edits the TARGET's sources). Override chips get accent borders; +%/lvl shown per row; header = edit count + Reset path/all. Selecting a skill (card click OR preview node click) also JUMPS the card list so that skill's card is at top (scrollToSel). (3) Preview (460px): real path art via PathArt.Get (retexture-aware, safe .dds; aspect drives height 320-720; TileTint fallback), all nodes unlocked-look via PsycastsUIUtility + level pips; selected node accent box + "Editing · <stat>", sources emerald boxes/tags/lines, empower targets gold (tab hover-pulse colors); node clicks focus without consuming. Below: "Live values — <pawn>" (Scalables, primary gilded) + "Scaling — edits apply live" (◂/▸ rates). FlatScroll everywhere (0xBE01-03).
**Layering (PsycastInfo):** PlayerTuning (settings overlay) > ManualBalance.json (baked) > frozenSyn > computed. Base* getters expose the pre-player baseline; only diffs are stored (re-picking the default clears). Mutations clear caches; WriteSettings on close/reset.
**Storage:** tunePrimStat/tunePrimStr (defName), tuneEdgeStat/tuneEdgeStr ("src|tgt"), tuneSrcs (defName -> "A;B;C").
**Bake support (mod settings, Specializations tab -> "Balance Edits"):** "Bake N edit(s) into mod defaults" -> ManualBalance.BakePlayerTuning: merges the player overlay over the currently-baked records (player wins; edge keys pipe->arrow converted), serializes ALL records (prim/edge with independent stat/str fields; srcs as semicolon lists) to <modRoot>/ManualBalance.json, reloads, clears the overlay (baked = new baseline), WriteSettings. Plus "Discard my balance edits". Both confirm-gated; works from main menu. Workshop-update caveat noted in the confirm text.
**Removed:** BalanceEditor.cs (HTML/JSON export).

## Unchanged
Brain hediffs; Apotheosis/Convergence/Illuminated/Singularity naming; dev tools (incl. Reset to non-psycaster); skills/synergies/specs/pilgrimages/ascensions.
